LanguageData.LL_GeologicalTerrainTip: On: new maps are reshaped by geological rules. Off: Living Landscapes only reads the terrain that map generation produced. Existing maps are never changed.
LanguageData.LL_GeologicalTerrainDesc:
Shapes new maps from geology: lakes sit in basins, rivers run downhill, and valleys and slopes follow drainage. Turn this off if you use a mod that changes map terrain and isn't listed as supported below; plants will still follow the terrain that mod creates. Only affects newly generated maps.
In development: this option has no effect yet.

LanguageData.LL_UnsupportedTerrainMods: Other mods that change terrain generation: {0}. If maps look wrong, turn geologically driven terrain off.
